scopes.sequential: one thread (no `ConcM`): a `Triple`/`*_run` lemma with `Mem.Seq`, or a pure function equation
scopes.single-step: one operation or one step of a concurrent program (a `WP` rule or a step fact); composed into a program theorem, not one by itself
scopes.single-schedule: one concrete oracle and fuel of `Sched.run`, computed by the kernel
scopes.bounded-schedules: a finite, enumerated set of schedules or a bounded fuel/oracle domain
scopes.all-schedules: every fuel and every oracle of `Sched.run` (the statement binds both)
